content: Neha Chauhan checks the status of her newly activated health insurance policy with Karan Joshi. She inquires about dental cleaning coverage, which Karan confirms is covered up to ₹2,000 per year under preventive care. Finally, Neha asks about the claims process, and Karan provides the online portal link along with a quick-start guide.

action_items: View the policy document via the provided link
Submit any future claims via the online portal: https://portal.dcodelabs.com/claims
Review the attached quick-start guide for claims
